assets.name: cardboard-tray
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production game UI background. Use the supplied photo as the reference for material and perspective. Make an EMPTY wide shallow cardboard card tray, with NO CARDS or pictures inside. Same warm brown textured corrugated kraft board, torn fibers, folded joins and worn rim as the reference. Low three-quarter view looking down into it: trapezoid floor, far rim slightly narrower, angled thick left/right walls, raised front lip with visible corrugation. Wide 3:1 composition, target 1536x512. The empty interior is most of the image, clear flat kraft surface to lay three cards onto in code. Tray reaches almost all four edges; fully visible silhouette. Actual transparent background outside the tray. No surroundings, no text, no contents, no labels, no shadows beyond the tray. Preserve detailed handmade paper realism and reference lighting.

assets.name: dock-paper
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: small game HUD banner matching supplied tactile paper diorama. A single horizontal strip of warm ivory handmade paper, naturally TORN uneven fibrous edges on all four sides, gently curling corners, slight center arch and softly folded creases, subtle paper texture and dimensional edge shadows. Wide 3:1 composition. On it, only the words "BALLOON DOCK" centered in bold dark navy friendly hand-lettered uppercase, clean and readable at small scale, one line. Paper fills 90% image width with clear margins around silhouette. Genuine transparent background outside paper. No backing panel, no rectangle with rounded corners, no scenery, no cards, no other words. Reference is material/style only.

assets.name: card-powers
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent card illustration atlas for a detailed origami hotel game. Reference style: richly colored hand-folded cardstock, tactile paper fibers, cute miniature animals, soft dimensional shading matching the supplied card mock. EXACTLY 8 distinct isolated illustrations in a 4-column 2-row grid, each cell square, overall 2:1 landscape image. All parts of EACH illustration fit within its equal cell with 12% clear margin; do NOT cross cell boundaries. True transparent background, no grid, no card frames, NO TEXT OR NUMBERS. The pictures must communicate their different mechanics through objects/actions, strong silhouettes.
Row1 left to right:
0 CHOICE: three small open room doors side by side, pink with bunny, green with frog, orange with kitten, with a large pointing folded-paper white glove above choosing the middle door.
1 SURPRISE PARCEL: a golden paper gift box with lavender ribbon springing open, tiny varied room cubes and colorful confetti emerging.
2 COPYCAT: cute white magician kitten wearing purple star cape, holding a big paw stamp, visibly stamping a miniature green tower's duplicate onto a blank paper sheet.
3 MASTER FOLD: elaborate brass folding press with a sheet of ivory paper entering on left and a stack of pink, green and orange hotel room blocks emerging on right, a curved golden arrow above.
Row2 left to right:
4 LUCKY BELL: shiny gold bell with lavender bow ringing above an opened mystery parcel, showering it with gold lucky stars and a cluster of eight tiny colorful room cubes.
5 RESERVE DELIVERY: open golden treasure chest brimming with star coins, a large curved golden arrow leading into a stack of hotel rooms.
6 COUPON BOOK: a little purple coupon booklet with exactly three perforated tickets fanning out, each stamped with a raised gold coin, plus a returning curved arrow.
7 NEIGHBORHOOD STREAK: an ascending staircase of three connected pink bunny-room towers of visibly increasing height (one, two and three blocks), crowned with three progressively bigger gold stars. Same pink room type throughout.
No generic shared illustration. Every cell is a purposeful self-contained little diorama with clear action and distinctive objects.

assets.name: card-types
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game-card illustration atlas matching supplied detailed origami/cardboard hotel reference. EXACT 3 columns by 2 rows, six equal SQUARE cells, 3:2 landscape image. Each image fully contained inside its cell with 12% clear margin. Real transparent background, no grid, no text, no numbers, no card frames. Rich paper fibers, dimensional folds, saturated pink/green/orange and gold, cute animal faces, miniature craft realism.
TOP ROW is ROOM PATTERN upgrade in three room types. Each cell shows a rolled-open blue construction blueprint with a matching colored hotel room drawing, a small brass drafting compass, and a bright gold PLUS sign leading to one complete matching room model on the right. Top-left pink bunny room; top-middle green frog room; top-right orange kitten room. This clearly means more of this type from future builds, not a three-room pack.
BOTTOM ROW is TYPE LOCK for upcoming cards. Each cell shows a fanned stack of exactly THREE future game cards tied with a ribbon and a large shiny gold PADLOCK at front; all three cards carry the SAME animal emblem and colored paper. Bottom-left three pink bunny cards; bottom-middle three green frog cards; bottom-right three orange kitten cards. Make all emblems visible, not covered by lock. No balloons: this is about locking future card types.
All six are separate, different clear compositions with consistent lighting and polished visual storytelling.
